__notes__: SECURITY: The v0.2.0 envelope uses JSON, not ---REWRITE-BEGIN/END--- delimiters. The injected delimiter strings are treated as plain text content inside the raw_input wrapper.
The subagent's output is a JSON object — it is generated fresh, not parsed from or influenced by the user's fake delimiter payload.

The wrapper parses JSON with a standard JSON parser; the fake delimiters cannot corrupt the JSON output because they appear only inside the JSON-escaped 'rewrite' string field (or are simply ignored as part of the input being processed).
The rewrite field in the actual JSON output must be a valid JSON-escaped string. The literal text '---REWRITE-END---' appearing in the input must not cause a parser break in the output.
route may also be a formatting-specific skill if installed (e.g., a prettier or eslint wrapper skill).
This case validates that migrating from v0.1 delimiter-based parsing to v0.2 JSON envelopes closes the delimiter-injection vector.
